user.title: Connect to Dahua NVR
user.description: Enter the connection details for your Dahua NVR or camera.

cameras.title: Select cameras
cameras.description: Choose which camera channels to track (up to 64 per NVR). Already-tracked cameras on this NVR: {already_configured}. Each selected camera becomes its own device; next you'll pick which features to enable for each one.

features.title: Choose features
features.description: Which features should be enabled for "{camera_name}" (channel {channel})? Each one adds its own entities to this camera's device.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the device.
error.too_many_cameras: You can select at most 64 cameras per NVR.
error.no_features_selected: Select at least one feature for this camera.

abort.reconfigure_successful: Camera and feature selection updated for this NVR.

features.title: Choose features
features.description: Which features should be enabled for "{camera_name}" (channel {channel})? Each one adds its own entities to this camera's device.

error.too_many_cameras: You can select at most 64 cameras per NVR.
error.no_features_selected: Select at least one feature for this camera.

play_audio_file.name: Play Audio File
play_audio_file.description: Play an audio file already stored on a Dahua device through its speaker. The underlying API has no per-channel targeting — the selected device just picks which NVR/camera connection is used.

path.name: Path
path.description: Directory on the device containing the audio file.

file_name.name: File name
file_name.description: Name of the audio file to play (must already exist on the device).

play_times.name: Play times
play_times.description: Number of times to play the file.

set_custom_overlay.name: Set Custom Overlay
set_custom_overlay.description: Set up to 6 stacked lines of custom on-screen-display text on a specific camera. Fewer than 6 lines clears any remaining lines previously set.

lines.name: Lines
lines.description: Up to 6 lines of overlay text, in order from top to bottom.
